description: Navigational aids (NDB, VOR, DME, VOR-DME, VORTAC, TACAN, ...) associated with one airfield from the OurAirports dataset: ident, name, type, frequency in kHz, coordinates, elevation, DME channel and power. Pass any code ourairports_lookup accepts. Most airfields have none on file (navaids are sparse relative to airports) -- that returns an empty list with found:true, not an error. An unrecognized airfield code is refused with a clear error, never an empty success.
name: airport_navaids
